dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: Is that a passing traveler I see?

dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: Sit with me, the view from here is incredible.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: They call me Ross — Ross the Quick!

dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: Especially the ones who are always trying to catch me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: That's a good question... What AM I doing here...

dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: I lost my way, then I got chased by a boar, then the hilichurls joined the chase...

dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: I ran until my legs gave out and my energy was gone — then I suddenly noticed this lake...

dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: Then I had this realization that I've spent my whole life running... running for no reason.

dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: No matter what, right now I am going to give myself a proper rest. Screw missions and all that.

dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: Although... There is the fact that if I don't report back to the gang soon, they'll fine me something like eight hundred thousand Mora... I forget how much exactly.

dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: ...Whatever, screw the gang of thieves too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Y—You're from a gang of th—thieves!?

dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: ...Hmm. Now you mention it, yes I am.

dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: Originally my mission was to find this place called the Abandoned City.

dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: ...But since I haven't reported back on my progress in so long, I've probably technically been kicked out of the gang by now.

dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: That said, if you're gonna report me, I won't run away...

dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: ...Either way, let me enjoy this view just a bit longer, won't you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Ross the Quick
dialogues.text: *sigh* Bye then.
